messages:
pritam: Heads-up: new hire hit schema.validate in the Node sample. The json-mode tool helper returned a JSON string when the SDK retried after auth refresh.

ellie: Ugh, we've seen similar. Can you paste the tiny repro?

pritam: Repro snippet:
```js
const out = await sdk.callTool('parse_profile', {text})
// expected: {name: '...'} (object)
// observed on retry: \"{\\\"name\\\":\"...\\\"}\" (string)
```

marc: Looks like retry path is returning raw body instead of running parseToolResult. Quick fix: have retry invoke the same parse pipeline. I'll send a patch.

ellie: For short-term onboarding noise reduction, can we add a one-liner in the sample README to coerce JSON strings into objects as a workaround?

marc: Yep. I'll open PRs: node fix and a tiny README patch. Also adding a unit test that fakes a 401+refresh so this doesn't regress.

ci-bot: Created issue #1744: "sdk: normalize json-mode outputs on retry (auth refresh)"  https://issues.redwood.ai/1744

ellie: After merge, please add a CI smoke job that runs the sample repro with a stubbed token endpoint and make it required for the sample app. That should reduce support tickets.

pritam: Thanks both. Paste PR links when ready and I'll update onboarding docs. :thumbsup:
